summary: Durable exact-close accounting with deterministic deferred outcome order and an atomic authoritative projection for ledger, learner, risk, Kelly and calibration; legacy torn-save recovery cannot split close consumers.
implementation: Pending closes keep first broker-flat time/tick, exit reason/regime/causal levels and entry identity; global deterministic ordering holds later outcomes behind earlier unresolved ones.
Only complete quantity-conserved strategy fills update ledger and downstream consumers; known orphans retain explicit exclusion; terminal zero-fill cleanup checks contradictory Execution rows.
Authoritative close_accounting.json atomically replaces the full accounting projection with checksum and preservation guards; commit failure rolls back every in-memory consumer.

Close transaction and legacy I/O share serialization; background save requests synchronous owner-loop capture/publication before legacy I/O, preventing mixed daily-state snapshots or stale checkpoint replacement.
Startup validates authority before legacy backup recovery and overlays committed state afterward; corrupt authority aborts startup; completed entry IDs remove stale legacy tracking.
Checkpoint retains legacy histories/counts rather than rebuilding or resetting; publication refuses count/history/identity regressions and PnL changes without an outcome.

Cross-session resolution preserves historical close time without adding old losses/cooldowns to today; existing pending closes bypass stale entry grace; tick floor and elapsed-time mapping prevent renewed delayed cooldowns.
Prospective entry_order_id persists in TradeRecord and all three legacy serialization paths; root-owned entry evidence hooks/sidecar preservation integrated.

A saved identified open position that closes while the process is down survives startup flat-symbol pruning and is reconciled at the first actual restarted observation; no historical observation time is fabricated.
